The remaining money in the Consumer Privacy Fund each fiscal year is allocated as follows: Ninety-one percent shall be invested by the Treasurer in financial assets, and nine percent shall be made available to the California Privacy Protection Agency for the purposes of making grants in California. The 3 percent grant shares are allocated to the following recipients:

1. Nonprofit organizations to promote and protect consumer privacy.
2. Nonprofit organizations and public agencies, including school districts, to educate children in the area of online privacy.
3. State and local law enforcement agencies to fund cooperative programs with international law enforcement organizations to combat fraudulent activities with respect to consumer data breaches.
